verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair ask for a SaaS equity-management platform, so the axis applies. Direct probes returned HTTP 404 for /llms.txt and for a markdown docs variant (/support.md). The support articles are ordinary human-oriented help pages, with no evidence of agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
